items.exampleEn: My brother plays in a band.
Can you take a photo of us?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我們拍張照嗎？

items.exampleEn: My favorite actor is in this movie.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜歡的演員在這部電影裡。

items.exampleEn: We saw a play at the theater.
items.exampleZh: 我們在劇院看了一齣戲。

items.sentenceEn: The famous actor came to our theater.
items.sentenceZh: 那位有名的演員來了我們的劇院。

items.audioEn: I play football on Saturday and paint on Sunday.
items.audioZh: 我星期六踢足球，星期天畫畫。

items.sentenceEn: This band is very famous in Japan.
items.sentenceZh: 這個樂團在日本很有名。

items.stemEn: She is a famous ____. She is in many movies.
items.stemZh: 她是有名的演員，演過很多電影。

items.stemEn: I ____ toy cars. I have fifty of them.
items.stemZh: 我收集玩具車，我有五十台。

items.passageEn: Mia's hobbies are art and music. She paints pictures of the blue sea, and she plays the guitar in a band. On the weekend, she goes to the theater with her friends. She also collects photos of famous actors. Her brother does not like art. He likes football.
items.passageZh: Mia 的嗜好是藝術和音樂。她畫藍色大海的圖，也在樂團裡彈吉他。週末她和朋友去劇院。她也收集知名演員的照片。她哥哥不喜歡藝術，他喜歡足球。

referenceEn: Can you take a photo of me?
Could you take a photo of me?
rubricZh: 「拍照」用 take a photo（寫 take a picture 也正確）
請求可用 Can you…?、Could you…? 等

items.instructionZh: 用 famous 造一個句子，說說一個有名的人或地方。
referenceEn: This singer is famous in Taiwan.
rubricZh: famous 放在 be 動詞後面或名詞前面（例如 is famous、a famous singer）
